newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to resume downtrend to 111-00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to resume downtrend to 111-00.

text.p: June gilt futures on LIFFE are in a corrective move, and likely to resume a downtrend towards 111-00 soon, technical analysts said on Thursday.
David Sneddon of Credit Suisse First Boston in London said the 112-20/112-29 band would cap any further strength for now.
"We are still treating this action of the past three days as a corrective move back upwards. In fact it looks very bear flaggy," Sneddon said.
This would provoke a re-test of support at 111-22/111-12. A likely breakdown from there would pave the way for 111-00 and subsequently to 110-20. June gilts opened 1/32 down at 112-09.
Sneddon said a further test of support would come in at around 110-06.
Gilts had a choppy ride on Wednesday, visiting both the highs and the lows of the recent range, but their failure to close above the previous day's high has kept the current bearish trend intact.
Sneddon said any upside moves would likely be capped at 112-30 which is both a Fibonacci resistance and the high on May 22. Some moderate resistance would initially come in at 112-20/21.
Further up, charts signalled a barrier at 113-06, then a much denser resistance at 113-16, Sneddon said.
Technical analysts at Chase in London however maintained that as long as the market stayed above 111-21 a bullish wave outlook would remain unchallenged.

According to this, a break above 112-20 would put a bottom in place on intraday charts allowing gains to target key resistance at 113-07. But a break of 113-07 was needed to trigger an Elliott buy signal opening initial upside potential to 113-23/26.
"The decline from 114-24 (May 9) to 111-21 (May 22) must be considered a buying opportunity," Chase analysts said. By 0815, Sept short sterling future was up three basis points at 93.16.
